title: Biracial and Afraid | Josh Ocean Thomas | Stand Up Comedy
description:
Josh Ocean Thomas on having an Arab mom and a white dad, how his mom can't detect AI, and being a sightseeing tour guide for the ocean

Comedy is at its best when there's a surprise – that's why Don't Tell Comedy puts on events where the performers and location are kept secret until the day of the show. With over 200 cities already in on the joke, you never know where we'll set up shop, or who might pop in. Want to be let in on the secret? Visit our website below to find an upcoming show near you: https://www.donttellcomedy.com

Just don't tell anyone!! 🤫

-----------------------------------------------------------

Josh Ocean Thomas is a Tunisian-American stand-up comedian based in Chicago. J.O.T. is headed to NYC to bring his energetic stage presence, quick wit, and larger-than-life physicality to the stage, along with some of his favorite comedians. From stories about his family and past relationships to sharp observations on his mixed cultural background, Josh delivers vibrant, relatable humor that connects with audiences everywhere.
